REGIME.name: REGIME
REGIME.definition: Entering new-pool WETH V3 structure (POOL_ONLY / random on same spine) with TP ladder + scheduled wallet. Money from 'being in the game', not from sieves.
REGIME.interpretation: Random ~$852 and POOL_ONLY ~$405 over the covered window show the regime (new pools + exits + capital rules) can print positive USD. That is NOT proof of a selectable edge over the baseline.

SELECTION.name: SELECTION
SELECTION.definition: Incremental scheduled PnL of large-buy / absorption sieves vs POOL_ONLY under identical scheduler (paired day bootstrap).
SELECTION.interpretation: SELECTION edge requires LBA paired Δ vs POOL_ONLY with day-cluster bootstrap p05 > 0. Beating random is a secondary check (does the sieve beat luck under same capacity).

EXECUTION.name: EXECUTION
EXECUTION.definition: Drag from latency, capacity skips, failed fills, conservative loss floors.
EXECUTION.interpretation: Skip rate 99.3% under 3-slot / one-token scheduler dominates. Unconstrained opportunity is diagnostic only — not tradable capital.

POOL_ONLY_explainer.what_it_is: POOL_ONLY = buy opportunities that pass only pool-structure filters (age 15m–24h, min size, depth/momentum/intensity score quantile), WITHOUT requiring a 'large buy' or 'absorbed' flag. Same $1000 wallet, 3 concurrent slots, one position per token, TP ladder exits.
POOL_ONLY_explainer.what_it_is_not: Not 'all Base swaps'. Not smart-money. Not proof you should trade randomly.
POOL_ONLY_explainer.why_random_can_look_good: CAPACITY_MATCHED_RANDOM picks the same count of eligible buys as POOL_ONLY from the same spine. If the regime itself has positive expected USD after costs, random can withdraw ~$500–$600 without any sieve edge.
